name: WOW-ADDON-UX
purpose: Improve WoW addon usability and presentation
cover: UI hierarchy, button placement, feedback, state readability, combat readability, dialogs, minimap interaction, error handling, user flow, performance, Lua robustness
mandatory_rules: Casinobabe.lua production = protected, WoW SavedVariables = protected, No speculative runtime modifications, No reload-dependent validation, No visual regression without screenshot/manual proof where appropriate
description: WoW addon UX skill that distinguishes technical correctness from actual player experience, focusing on usability and presentation improvements.
